clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 15885 specifies requirements for protective helmets for motorcyclists. All helmets sold in India must bear the ISI mark — it is illegal to sell non-ISI-certified helmets. Covers impact absorption, penetration resistance, chin strap strength, and field of vision requirements. Helmets must bear ISI mark with CM/L number. Penalty for selling non-ISI helmets: up to ₹1 lakh fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year under BIS Act 2016.

clauses.title: Test and Performance Requirements
clauses.text:
Helmet requirements under IS 15885:
- Impact absorption: Peak deceleration shall not exceed 300g in any impact test
- Penetration resistance: The test striker shall not contact the headform
- Chin strap: Must withstand 15 kN static load without rupture
- Retention system: Dynamic roll-off test — helmet shall not come off
- Field of vision: Minimum 105° horizontal on each side, 25° above and 45° below
- Weight: Maximum 1.5 kg (full face), 1.2 kg (open face)
- Visor: If fitted, must meet optical requirements of IS 14766
